description: This file defines the tlRole class, which manages role objects within the TestLink project, including CRUD operations, rights management, and user role associations.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents a user role with properties, rights, and database interaction methods within TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a tlRole object, setting database table and configuration.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets role properties based on options.

methods.name: copyFromCache
methods.description: Copies role data from another tlRole object.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Loads role data from the database.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Saves role data to the database.

methods.name: checkDetails
methods.description: Validates role details before saving.

methods.name: doesRoleExist
methods.description: Checks if a role with the given name exists.

methods.name: checkRoleName
methods.description: Validates the role name.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display-friendly role name.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the role from the database.

methods.name: replaceUserRolesWith
methods.description: Replaces all user roles with a new role.

methods.name: getUsersWithGlobalRole
methods.description: Retrieves users with this global role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithGlobalRole
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of users with this global role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithTestProjectRole
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of users with this test project role.

methods.name: getUserIDsWithTestPlanRole
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of users with this test plan role.

methods.name: getUsersWithTestProjectRole
methods.description: Retrieves users with test project role.

methods.name: getUsersWithTestPlanRole
methods.description: Retrieves users with test plan role.

methods.name: getAllUsersWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves all users with any role (global, test plan, or test project).

methods.name: hasRight
methods.description: Checks if the role has a specific right.

methods.name: deleteRightsFromDB
methods.description: Deletes all rights associated with the role from the database.

methods.name: addRightsToDB
methods.description: Adds rights to the role in the database.

methods.name: readRights
methods.description: Loads rights associated with the role.

methods.name: buildRightsArray
methods.description: Builds an array of rights from database info.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a role object by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all roles with optional filtering.

methods.name: getByIDs
methods.description: Method not implemented.

methods.name: getRoleColourCfg
methods.description: Returns color configuration for roles.
